levels.title: E N C O R E
levels.riddle: A record, a disc, a microphone, a stick and a harmonica. Find the light that lets them sing.
levels.hint: Light from the right and a little below. The two discs become the notes; the microphone and drumstick hold them up.
levels.complete:
ENCORE
Two notes, played by everything on the shelf.

levels.title: G O O D   B O Y
levels.riddle: Kibble, a ball, a treat, a sock, two chews, a rope and a bowl. Someone is waiting by the door.
levels.hint: Keep the light low and in front. The bag is the body, the ball the head, two chews are legs and the rope wags.
levels.complete:
GOOD BOY
Everything he owns, and the one thing he stole.

levels.title: B R I G H T   I D E A
levels.riddle: A clock, a pencil cup, sticky notes, an eraser and three things to write with. It is late, and something is coming.
levels.hint: Hold the light low, below the pile. The clock is round; the cup and the notes make the base; the pens shine.
levels.complete:
BRIGHT IDEA
The desk at midnight, just before it clicks.
